These fees are not printed on the Terrace Garden Memorial Path price sheet, which states a sales price and a rights-of-interment count and nothing else. They are the Mountain View Columbarium, June 2026 schedule, applied to this whole area — the niche bank and the nine additional properties alike — by operator ruling of 2026-07-29. Confirm current fees in MIS/Enterprise before writing.
Niche bank: row A is the bottom row, row E the top; niches are numbered 1–8 left to right. References read TGN-<row>-<n>.
Additional properties are numbered TGMP-1 … TGMP-9 in the order the pricing sheet prints them; their dimensions are the sheet's own catalog dimensions.
$762,000 available at list across 49 properties, 100 rights of interment — sales prices only, E.C.F. and fees are additional. Availability shown is maintained by hand — always confirm current status in MIS/Enterprise before writing.
There is no reflection pool. The path replaced it, and the ossuary block beside it, in full; both were drawn on the older “what was replaced” layout sketch and appear in neither the PHASE 2 render nor any 2026 site photograph. Terrace Garden Ossuary scattering is priced on the separate Scattering Garden sheet and is not priced here.
Layout — the walk, its round turn-around, the paved apron, the beds either side and which object stands where — is read off the official PHASE 2 overhead render and the June/July 2026 photographs. Every number is an estimate: there is no site plan. The render draws the beds as turf; the built garden is bark mulch, and the model follows the photographs. The niche bank’s position across the far end is estimated — the render floats it over the garden as a callout rather than showing it in place.
